3D objects, often shared online, may contain sensitive data.
Encryption [3] ensures confidentiality but reduces compressibility.
- Adjustable protection to match security needs.
- Format compliant, no auxiliary data needed.
- Novel 3D protection via reversible geometric deformations.
- Preserve compression rate with tunable protection strength.
- Natural aspect and coherent deformation compare to noise with encryption.
- Future work: develop new geometric deformations methods.
- Reorder vertices by increasing geodesic distance.
- Preserve spatial locality and enable coherent deformation.
